# Franco Seiler

> Software studio based in Córdoba, Argentina, building custom platforms and
> business automations for teams in the US, Canada, Europe and Latin America
> whose operations have outgrown spreadsheets. Clients work directly with the
> team building their software — no account managers, no handoffs.

## What we do

- Custom web application development (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js)
- Business process automation for operations that have outgrown spreadsheets
- Payment and billing integrations (Mercado Pago, Stripe, webhooks)
- Backend architecture: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication
- AI integration into existing products
- E-commerce development

## How we work

Franco Seiler leads projects end to end, from first idea to production. The core team stays
small; trusted specialists join when a project calls for them. That means
senior-level attention without the overhead of a traditional agency.

The code, infrastructure and ownership stay with the client — nothing is rented
from a platform.

## Facts

- Location: Córdoba, Argentina (GMT-3)
- Clients: United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Experience: 4+ years
- Case studies published: 20+

English only. Full URL list in
